latest_news.headline: Israel expands Lebanon ground offensive
latest_news.text: BBC/NPR/CBC report Israeli forces seized Beaufort Castle and expanded the southern Lebanon operation beyond prior lines.

latest_news.headline: France seeks UNSC emergency session on Lebanon
latest_news.text: France requested an emergency UN Security Council meeting as Israel deepened its Lebanese incursion.

latest_news.headline: US guides ships through Hormuz
latest_news.text: New York Times reports the U.S. military is quietly guiding ships through the Strait of Hormuz amid Iran war maritime risk.

latest_news.headline: Iran nuclear talks unresolved
latest_news.text: Reports say Iran’s retained highly enriched uranium remains its strongest card while talks continue without a final deal.

latest_news.headline: Zelensky warns of fresh Russian strike
latest_news.text: Ukraine reporting says Zelensky warned Russia is preparing a fresh major strike while peace-talk positioning continues.

latest_news.headline: Zaporizhzhia nuclear safety incident
latest_news.text: IAEA-linked reporting says a drone incident damaged the Zaporizhzhia plant exterior, with no radioactive leakage reported.

latest_news.headline: North Korea missile activity persists
latest_news.text: Yonhap/MSN-linked reports reference recent North Korean ballistic missile activity and Pyongyang rejecting denuclearisation pressure.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan-Afghan TTP friction persists
latest_news.text: Express Tribune reports Kabul warning to TTP failed to convince Islamabad; Pakistan-linked outlets report militants killed in operations.

latest_news.headline: Sudan drone attacks drive civilian deaths
latest_news.text: UN-linked reporting warns drone attacks are driving civilian deaths; activists report a deadly RSF drone strike in El Fasher.

latest_news.headline: West Bank/Gaza violence continues
latest_news.text: TRT World reports Israeli operations extended in Tulkarem and Nur Shams; Arab News reports a fatal Deir al-Balah strike.
